name: smwmusic-the-addams-family-up-and-down-in-and-out
title: The Addams Family - Up and Down, In and Out
description:
Upbeat relaxing song that plays in the Hall of Stairs. Could be used for any sort of safe area.

The Addams Family and SMW were the first two video games I have memories of (both early SNES games).

I went for 1:1, but it seems like the original song did some weird things to peak out the SPC700 and make an obscure echo effect on the slapbass, so it's close but not perfectly 1:1.

The notes in this song are tuned slightly flat, as the original song does the same.

Thanks to KevinM, com_poser, and Exodustx0 for their help with my first port. If this is well-received or otherwise constructive, I'd like to make more.
